brief:
The Arab Parliament is launching a worldwide parliamentary initiative in support of Palestine on December 10 in Cairo, Shehab Wire reported. Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas will participate alongside Arab and international parliamentarians.

The initiative aims to mobilize parliamentary support across the globe for the Palestinian cause. The launch event will bring together legislators from multiple countries and regions to coordinate advocacy efforts.

title: Arab Parliament launches global initiative for Palestine
